scope: offline static review of the pinned mask ROM and original 1716-byte EEPROM overlay; no device access

candidate_behavior.startup: D28D: MOV R0,#FF; CLR A; loop MOV @R0,A / DJNZ R0 until R0 wraps to 00; MOV SP,#3C; LJMP D2B2
candidate_behavior.effect: Clears internal RAM FF through 01, sets the stack pointer, then halts in a tight loop. It does not return.

raw_candidate_4D2F_to_D2B3.result: false positive caused by scanning bytes without instruction alignment
raw_candidate_4D2F_to_D2B3.implication: There is no LJMP D2B3 at 4D2F.

2CDC_to_D280.overlay_flow: Starting at D280 executes SETB bit A2, the F814 writes at D282-D289, then LJMP D2A6 at D28A. It exits before D28D.
2CDC_to_D280.implication: A real entry reaches the nearby D280 sequence, but that sequence does not fall through into the candidate startup.

aligned_rom_transfers.direct_targets_in_candidate_ranges: No aligned direct ROM transfer to D28D-D298 or D2B2-D2B3 was identified.

real_or_plausible_sites.0478: JMP @A+DPTR; immediately preceded by MOV DPTR,#03D3, so this reviewed dispatch is based in mask ROM.
real_or_plausible_sites.08A0: JMP @A+DPTR after four calls to 08A1. Reviewed call sites load code pointers in the Cxxx mask-ROM region; full input coverage is not proven.
real_or_plausible_sites.092A: JMP @A+DPTR with A cleared and DPTR assembled from bytes read through MOVC; a table can select the exact destination, so this remains a computed-reference audit item.
real_or_plausible_sites.2B52: JMP @A+DPTR is followed by table-shaped bytes; this pass did not bound all possible destinations.

raw_73_false_positives_checked.21B5: Immediate operand 73 of MOV R5,#73 at 21B4.
raw_73_false_positives_checked.288D: Immediate operand 73 in MOV DPTR,#C773 beginning at 288B.
raw_73_false_positives_checked.403B: Relative branch displacement of JNC 40AF at 403A.

computed_transfer_review.limitation: The reviewed roots and table cases still do not bound every runtime DPTR value or every computed entry into the overlay. Static evidence supports retaining D28D-D298 and D2B2-D2B3 as a dead-code candidate, not deleting them as proven unreachable.
